relationships.subject: CFA inflammatory pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Peripheral inflammation induced by injection of complete Freund's Adjuvant (CFA) induced potentiation of α-amino-3-hydroxy-5-methyl-4-isoxazolepropionic receptor (AMPAR) currents with a presynaptic component in layer II/III of the ACC

relationships.subject: dopamine
relationships.evidence_quote: After four days of inflammatory pain, the dopamine-mediated inhibition of AMPAR currents was significantly reduced in the ACC

relationships.subject: CFA inflammatory pain
relationships.evidence_quote: dopamine neurotransmitter concentration in the ACC was reduced three days following CFA

key_findings: CFA inflammation potentiates ACC layer II/III AMPAR currents, reduces dopamine inhibition of them, and lowers ACC dopamine content.
